data.long_meaning: A mythological divine tree in Hinduism that grants all wishes. The name Kalpvriksha carries the meaning “Wish-fulfilling divine tree” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kalpvriksha usually hope their child will grow to embody wish-fulfilling divine tree and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalpvriksha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

This tree holds a special place in Hindu literature as a symbol of divine grace and blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Kalpvriksha" is deeply symbolic of the infinite grace and compassion of the divine. The Kalpvriksha tree is also referred to as the 'wish-fulfilling tree' in Hindu scriptures. It is believed that one who touches the leaves of the tree is granted a boon or a wish. The tree is said to have originated from the mind of Lord Brahma himself.

In video games, it is featured as a quest objective or a powerful artifact.
